name: linkup
description: LinkUp is a social media platform developed as a Bachelor's thesis project. It enables seamless communication and content sharing among users. The platform offers real-time chats, group conversations, file sharing, and Markdown-based posts — all wrapped in a clean, responsive user interface. The focus is on delivering a reliable, user-friendly experience that supports modern social interaction needs.

scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,react,next,ws" -c "green,cyan,gray,magenta" "pnpm --filter backend start" "pnpm --filter web-react preview" "pnpm --filter web-next start" "pnpm --filter websocket start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,react,next,ws" -c "green,cyan,gray,magenta" "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter web-react dev" "pnpm --filter web-next dev" "pnpm --filter websocket dev"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n "backend,react,next" -c "green,cyan,gray" "pnpm --filter backend lint" "pnpm --filter web-react lint" "pnpm --filter web-next lint"
